presets.name: Vine Tendril
presets.desc:
A singular vine that is under control by the Vine Princess.

Shares initiative with all other Vine Tendrils.

If a target gets hit then another party member must attack it to free them, removing one token. They can also attack once the target is immobile to free them fully.

actions.name: Tangle
actions.notes: Zero damage, but once used on target (and hit) then add a Wrapped Token, once three Wrapped Tokens are accumulated the target is immobile. After one turn of being immobile the target gets dragged away.

presets.name: Vine Guardian
presets.desc: A humanoid made of tangled vines that quickly sprouts from any nearby vine connected to the heart. It can untangle itself, wrap around a target, then retangle to trap them

actions.name: Lunge
actions.notes: Make a huge leap forward to attack a target.

actions.name: Encase
actions.notes: Wrap yourself around an enemy to trap them inside yourself. causing an instant immobile effect which can be removed within one turn otherwise you run off with the person inside you.
